title: Ornate Purple Mask
description: A close-up of a single decorative theatrical mask centered against a solid dark background. The mask features a glossy purple and gold surface adorned with handprints, spiral patterns, circular motifs, and small dragonflies, with black eye cutouts and a gentle smiling expression.
prompt: A highly detailed realistic painting of an ornate theatrical mask floating against a dark background. The mask has a smooth glossy surface in shades of purple, lavender and warm gold. Decorated with multiple handprints, swirling line patterns, circular embossed motifs, and tiny dragonflies. Black almond-shaped eye holes and a gentle smiling mouth with peach lips. Dramatic lighting with soft highlights and subtle drips, mystical and elegant atmosphere.
